title: An exception in the footnote
description: The qualification in the footnote must survive extraction.
construction: A small, readable footnote qualifies the main sentence. Both passages and the * marker that links them are tested; whether a reader would associate them is not.

document.text: Contact the service desk for assistance.
* Except public holidays in the service region.

checks.label: Footnote exception
checks.expected: * Except public holidays in the service region.
